# Page 17^page=17
Q. Consider the following statements regarding the Tex-RAMPS Scheme: 1. Tex-RAMPS aims to promote Global Textile Leadership through an integrated framework focusing on research, data systems, capacity development, and start-up support. 2. The Integrated Textiles Statistical System (ITSS) under Tex-RAMPS is intended to strengthen data analytics and diagnostics for evidence-based policy making in the textile sector. 3. Under Tex-RAMPS, commercial banks are mandated to provide direct capital subsidies to textile start- ups as part of the Start-up & Innovation component. Which of the statements given above is/are correct? (a) 1 and 2 only (b) 2 and 3 only (c) 1 and 3 only (d) 1, 2 and 3 (e) 1 only

# Page 19^page=19
Q. Consider the following statements regarding the National Technical Textiles Mission (NTTM): 1. Under Component I, an outlay of ₹1,000 crore has been allocated for research in Carbon, Aramid and Nylon fibres along with application-based research. 2. The mission aims to increase technical textile exports from ₹14,000 crore to ₹20,000 crore through the establishment of a new Export Promotion Council. 3. Component II of the mission targets increasing the domestic market size of technical textiles to $100 billion by 2024. Which of the statements given above is/are correct? (a) 1 and 2 only (b) 2 and 3 only (c) 1 and 3 only (d) 1, 2 and 3 (e) None of the Above
